mapper.select: SELECT ci.cart_item_id AS cartItemId, ci.member_id AS memberId, ci.product_id AS productId, p.image_path AS imagePath, p.product_name AS productName, p.brand AS brand, p.price AS price, ci.quantity AS quantity, p.stock AS stock, (ci.quantity * p.price) AS itemTotalPrice FROM cart_item ci JOIN product p ON ci.product_id = p.product_id WHERE ci.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY ci.cart_item_id DESC
SELECT CART_ITEM_ID AS cartItemId, MEMBER_ID AS memberId, PRODUCT_ID AS productId, QUANTITY AS quantity FROM CART_ITEM WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND PRODUCT_ID = #{productId}
SELECT cart_item_id AS cartItemId, member_id AS memberId, product_id AS productId, quantity AS quantity FROM cart_item WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND cart_item_id = #{cartItemId}
SELECT nvl(sum(p.price * ci.quantity),0) FROM CART_ITEM ci JOIN PRODUCT p ON ci.PRODUCT_ID =p.PRODUCT_ID WHERE ci.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cart_item( cart_item_id, member_id, product_id, quantity, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( seq_cart_item.NEXTVAL, #{memberId}, #{productId}, #{quantity}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE CART_ITEM SET QUANTITY = #{quantity}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE CART_ITEM_id = #{cartItemId} AND MEMBER_id = #{memberId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM cart_item WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND cart_item_id = #{cartItemId}
